payload.artist_html: P. C. Sereno, N. Myhrvold, D. M. Henderson, F. E. Fish, D. Vidal,, S. L. Baumgart, T. M. Keillor, K. K. Formoso & Lauren L. Conroy
payload.credit_html: "Spinosaurus is not an aquatic dinosaur"
payload.description_html: Anterior dorsal centrum referable to Spinosaurus mirabilis (originally Spinosaurus sp., from Brusatte and Sereno, 2007: Fig. 9). Photographs and line drawings of MNBH IGU11 from the Echkar Formation (Cenomanian) of Niger in ventral (A) dorsal (B), right lateral (C), and posterior (D) views. Cross-hatching indicates broken bone. ana, articular surface for the neural arch; hy, hypapophysis; k, ventral keel; nc, neural canal; pa, parapophysis; pc, pleurocoel. Scale bar, 5 cm.
